bbs_note: w3bs.org/bbs is the tsbb board in ~/www/w3bs.org-bbs (port 3341, vault w3bs-org-bbs--prod). It follows tsbb releases on its own.
social_note: social.w3bs.org is the Bluesky web client (social-app's bskyweb, ~/www/w3bs.org-social-web, port 3343) with the AT Protocol PDS paths (/xrpc, /oauth, /@atproto, /.well-known, /account) sent to the PDS in ~/www/w3bs.org-social (port 3342, vault w3bs-org-social--prod); *.social.w3bs.org handle hosts go straight to the PDS. w3bs.org/social is the app's page about it.
